title: Gitanjali in Bodo: Nobel Laureate Rabindranath Tagore's Verses
author: Rabindranath Tagore

hymns.theme: The Vessel of Life Filled with Infinite Song
hymns.bodo_dev:
नों आंखौ जोबनो गैयै खालामबाय, बेनो नोंनि गोसो;
बे लेस्रा बासनखौ नों खेबसे-खेबनै खुबैयो,
आरो गावनि गोजां जिउजों बुंफबहोनो फैयो।
नोंनि आखायनि थावनाय जों आंनि गोरबोआ रंजादों।
hymns.bodo_rom:
Nwhn angkhwo jwbnw gwywi khalambay, benw nwhnni gwsw;
Be lesra baswnkhwo nwhn khebse-khebnwi khubwyw,
Aro gawni gwojang jiujwng bungfwhwnw fwiyw.
Nwhnni akhayni thaonay jwng angni gworboa rwangjadwng.
hymns.english:
Thou hast made me endless, such is thy pleasure.
This frail vessel thou emptiest again and again, and fillest it ever with fresh life.
At the immortal touch of thy hands my little heart loses its limits in joy.

hymns.song_no: Song 35 (Gitanjali 35: Where the mind is without fear)
hymns.theme: Where the mind is without fear
